description: This file contains the implementation of a custom SearchSession wrapper class which delegates calls to an underlying SearchSession instance, adding event publishing functionality before search operations. It handles search session behavior specific to the OpenMRS project's Hibernate Search integration.

classes.name: EventPublisherDelegatingSearchSession
classes.description: A wrapper class implementing SearchSession that delegates all methods to an underlying SearchSession instance, while adding event publishing logic for search creation events.

methods.name: search(Collection)
methods.description: Creates a new search query for the given collection of entity classes, notifying listeners via event publisher before returning the search object.

methods.name: search(SearchScope)
methods.description: Creates a new search query for the given search scope, notifying listeners via event publisher before returning the search object.

methods.name: schemaManager
methods.description: Returns the schema manager for given entity classes.

methods.name: workspace
methods.description: Returns the search workspace for the specified entity classes.

methods.name: massIndexer
methods.description: Returns a mass indexer for the specified entity classes.

methods.name: scope
methods.description: Creates a search scope over the specified entity classes.

methods.name: scope
methods.description: Creates a search scope for a specific entity class and associated indexes.

methods.name: automaticIndexingSynchronizationStrategy
methods.description: Sets the strategy for automatic indexing synchronization.

methods.name: indexingPlanSynchronizationStrategy
methods.description: Sets the strategy for indexing plan synchronization.

methods.name: indexingPlanFilter
methods.description: Sets the filter for the indexing plan.
